name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, "probe/**"]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4.3.0
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.4
      - run: sh scripts/install-gitleaks.sh "$HOME/.local/bin" && echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run test
      - run: bun run typecheck
      - run: shellcheck get.sh hedge fleet templates/profile/install.sh scripts/*.sh packs/*/hooks/*.sh packs/*/lib/*.sh packs/*/sync/*.sh proof/*.sh
  install-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4.3.0
      - name: Move the runner's gh aside, so get.sh has to install it
        run: sudo mv "$(command -v gh)" /usr/local/share/gh-runner
      - name: A new Linux user runs get.sh, hedge setup, and hedge doctor from this tree
        run: sudo HEDGE_PROOF_ENGINE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" sh proof/fresh-linux.sh
  gitleaks-install:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest, macos-15-intel]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4.3.0
      - run: sh scripts/install-gitleaks.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin"
      - run: test "$("$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/gitleaks" version)" = 8.21.2
  privacy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4.3.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - run: sh scripts/install-gitleaks.sh "$HOME/.local/bin" && echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Pick the base commit
        env:
          PR_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PUSH_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          base=${PR_BASE:-$PUSH_BEFORE}
          if [ -z "$base" ] || ! git cat-file -e "$base^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            base=--all
          fi
          echo "BASE=$base" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Scan for secrets and private terms
        env:
          FLEET_PRIVACY_DENYLIST: ${{ secrets.FLEET_PRIVACY_DENYLIST }}
        run: sh scripts/privacy-scan.sh "$BASE"
      - name: Scan the pull request title and body
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          FLEET_PRIVACY_DENYLIST: ${{ secrets.FLEET_PRIVACY_DENYLIST }}
        # Read from the event file, not step env: the runner prints step env values in the log.
        run: |
          jq -r '.pull_request.title, (.pull_request.body // "")' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/pr-text" 2>/dev/null ||
            { echo "privacy: could not read the pull request text; failing closed." >&2; exit 2; }
          sh scripts/privacy-scan.sh --text <"$RUNNER_TEMP/pr-text"

# Agent rules

Confirm before a destructive action.

## Pull requests

Open every pull request as a draft.
